name: useful-claude-add-ons
description: Internal marketplace of Claude Code skills and plugins for the team - APIs, security tooling, workflow automation, and productivity add-ons.

plugins.name: aws-opensearch
plugins.description: Diagnose and remediate Amazon OpenSearch Service managed domains over SigV4, with dry-run guards on destructive calls.

plugins.name: bitbucket
plugins.description: Git over HTTPS with Atlassian API tokens plus the Bitbucket Cloud REST API - PRs, pipelines, comments, branches.

plugins.name: checkpoint-email
plugins.description: Check Point Email Security (Harmony Email & Collaboration / Avanan) - search, triage, and remediate with dry-run gates.

plugins.name: cisco-meraki
plugins.description: Cisco Meraki Dashboard API v1 - inventory, status, event and config-change logs, live diagnostics, and MX/MS/MR config changes with snapshot/diff/confirm and rollback.

plugins.name: claude-code-defaults
plugins.description: Configure how Claude Code behaves by default - CLAUDE.md instructions, settings.json, permission allow/deny/ask rules and modes, hooks, default model, and which scope (user/project/local/managed) each belongs in.

plugins.name: claude-code-tuneup
plugins.description: Audit a Claude Code install for what makes it slow or bloated - duplicate skills, per-tool-call hooks, SessionStart injections, disabled-but-installed plugins, overlapping MCP servers, oversized CLAUDE.md - and return a ranked cleanup plan.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Cloudflare v4 API - DNS, zones, cache, WAF, page rules, SSL/TLS, Workers/KV/R2, Zero Trust, analytics.

plugins.name: doc-builder
plugins.description: Finished documents as DOCX and PDF through Word, or LibreOffice where Word is absent - findings reports via HTML, screenshot SOPs via OOXML - with the house style supplied by whichever brand pack is installed, and eight built-in themes (professional, corporate, blue, red, modern, dark, midnight, high-contrast) plus a compact density, previewed in a gallery shipped with the skill. Also install solomon-doc-builder for automatic Solomon house style; --brand neutral (or DOC_BUILDER_BRAND=neutral) always turns branding off.

plugins.name: drata
plugins.description: Drata Public API - controls, monitoring tests, evidence, personnel, policies, frameworks, risks across US/EU/APAC.

plugins.name: exchange-mailbox-cleanup
plugins.description: Walks a non-technical operator through Exchange Online mailbox cleanup and offboarding - preflight, litigation hold, preservation check, account deletion - with typed confirmation on every irreversible step.

plugins.name: exchange-mailbox-restore
plugins.description: Walks a non-technical operator through restoring a mailbox or removing a hold - triage on mailbox state, then exactly one of five mutually exclusive paths.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub branch protection and repository rulesets via gh - read both gate surfaces, export them to a file, remove them, and restore from that export.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: ADHD-friendly output shaping - leads with next action, numbers steps, suppresses tangents. Manual invoke via /i-have-adhd.

plugins.name: infra-work-ticketing
plugins.description: Infrastructure work ticketing for Zoho ServiceDesk Plus Cloud and Jira Cloud - confirm a ticket exists, log work notes as the work happens, or open a ticket.

plugins.name: intune-graph
plugins.description: Microsoft Intune via Microsoft Graph - device troubleshooting, compliance/config profiles, app deployment, report exports.

plugins.name: jira-manager
plugins.description: Jira Cloud over the REST API with email + API token - JQL search, create, update, assign, transition, comment, log work. No MCP connector.

plugins.name: knowbe4-admin
plugins.description: KnowBe4 KSAT admin: diagnose SCIM sync against Entra ID or Okta, pull reporting data, and make changes on the correct surface.

plugins.name: mermaid-svg-bitbucket
plugins.description: Pre-render Mermaid diagrams to committed SVG so they display correctly in Bitbucket Cloud.

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Notify a session's progress to your phone or inbox - a two-way Telegram bot (questions wait for your reply, topic-per-job dispatcher) or email over SMTP/an MCP connector.

plugins.name: obsidian-canvas
plugins.description: Create and edit Obsidian Canvas (.canvas) files directly as JSON Canvas - architecture maps, decision trees, and boards with embedded live notes, groups, and labeled arrows; no plugin or REST bridge required.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault-server
plugins.description: Self-hosted Obsidian vault on Ubuntu - containerised desktop app, obsidian.md Sync, and the Local REST API MCP endpoint over an SSH tunnel.

plugins.name: power-automate-api
plugins.description: Power Automate cloud flows through the API instead of the maker portal - definitions, expressions, triggers, connection references, run history, and the Flow/BAP auth errors.

plugins.name: repo-docs
plugins.description: Generate and refresh a full documentation set for a codebase - CLAUDE.md, READMEs, API reference, architecture doc, TODO/SECURITY/CHANGELOG, and handoff notes.

plugins.name: report-builder
plugins.description: Deprecated 2026-09-10, superseded by doc-builder. Redirect stub only.

plugins.name: shipstation
plugins.description: ShipStation across V2, legacy V1, and ShipEngine - shipments, labels, rates, carriers, warehouses, inventory, products, orders, tracking, batches, manifests.

plugins.name: solomon-doc-builder
plugins.description: Brand pack only: the Solomon Associates house style for doc-builder. Palette, template and footer, no logic of its own. Install alongside doc-builder for automatic Solomon branding; doc-builder's --brand neutral always opts back out.

plugins.name: solomon-sop-maker
plugins.description: Deprecated 2026-09-10, superseded by doc-builder with the solomon-doc-builder brand pack. Redirect stub only.

plugins.name: sophos-central
plugins.description: Sophos Central API - endpoint management, alert triage, SIEM export, XDR/Live Discover, firewall management.

plugins.name: terraform-docs-readme
plugins.description: Regenerate a Terraform module's README.md with terraform-docs - .terraform-docs.yml, main.tf header block, footer.md, and the BEGIN_TF_DOCS/END_TF_DOCS injection markers.

plugins.name: visio-diagrams
plugins.description: Create, edit, and verify Microsoft Visio .vsdx diagrams - stdlib-only generator from a YAML/JSON spec with no Visio install needed, plus COM automation for real stencil masters.

plugins.name: wazuh-onprem
plugins.description: Self-hosted Wazuh across Server API, Indexer API, Dashboard saved-objects API, and ossec.conf over SSH.

plugins.name: web-research
plugins.description: Live-web research through the Perplexity MCP server - routes each question to search, ask, research or reason, with recency and domain filters, and hands library and API reference to Context7 instead.

plugins.name: web-testing-playwright
plugins.description: Drive a real browser with Playwright - screenshots across viewports, console errors, failed requests, form and login flows, plus Windows/Linux browser setup.

plugins.name: work-log-reporter
plugins.description: Per-session work log in a committed work-log/ directory, plus a formatted email report with a PDF attachment sent over SMTP.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Virtual dev team for multi-repo legacy work - one interactive session owns a ticket from brainstorm through spec, plan, implement, tests, docs and review to done; 4 context-isolated agents (explorer, reviewer, security, researcher) plus on-demand stack skills, 34 slash commands, 29 bundled skills, and deterministic hooks: a budgeted context hook (on by default) that carries the handoff across a clear or compaction, plan-approval and scope guards with a completion audit, an opt-in cloud/destructive guard, and a verify gate that fails unverified turns. /crew:migrate carries a 0.20 setup forward.

plugins.name: gizmoduck
plugins.description: Nuclei vulnerability scans on hosts and websites, diffed against a baseline, rendered as triaged Markdown/HTML/PDF reports that itemise Critical/High/Medium and count the rest, and turned into ServiceDesk Plus tickets for Critical and High findings after one batch confirmation. No hooks, no agents.

plugins.name: localgpu
plugins.description: Local models on your own GPU via Ollama, in two halves - three MCP tools that index a repo or folder into a vector store on disk, search it, and answer from it, plus a `localgpu` command that opens a separate Claude Code session on a local chat model through a translating proxy. Commands for setup, health checks, indexing, search, ask, and pointing crew at a local model. No hooks and no agents; no prompt, file, or embedding leaves the machine.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault
plugins.description: Make one or more Obsidian vaults Claude Code's durable, token-efficient memory - cross-platform, multi-vault setup and health checks for the Local REST API bridge (one MCP server per vault), a vault contract guard whose frontmatter and ASCII rules ship off and whose canvas shape check ships on, gardening and reflection agents, canvas and map-of-content generation, and graphify wiring into a separate codegraphs vault.

plugins.name: rule-of-two
plugins.description: Two adversarial reviewers from different model families - a Claude agent and a Codex agent - tear apart a Claude Code agent, skill or plugin against one shared rubric and return a viability verdict with cited defects, weaknesses and the edits worth making. Use when reviewing a skill, agent, command or plugin as an artifact: 'is this skill worth shipping', 'tear apart this plugin', 'will this agent's description actually trigger', 'review my SKILL.md', 'does this duplicate something we already have'. Coverage is a reported outcome: if only one reviewer runs, or the two models cannot be resolved to different families, the report says so in its own title rather than passing a single-family opinion off as two. Do NOT use for architecture, implementation plans, product ideas or code diffs - use crew's architect-reviewer, planner or code-reviewer. Standalone - its own two-model config, never crew's. No hooks.
